title: Microsoft Teams: consecutive interpretation in Interpreter, billed in Copilot Credits
summary: The billing prerequisites, spending controls and meeting-policy command are supported by Microsoft's documentation. Minor clarifications should flag conflicting License administrator permissions in the setup documentation, retain the notice's public-preview context, and label the missing control as a separate meeting-policy switch.
